contracts.name: Native drawing projects and drawing API
contracts.compatibility: Keep version 1 readable and preserve version 2 draw/input signatures and primitive arguments.
contracts.change_policy: Review the file format, generator instructions, native renderer and saved examples together.
contracts.rationale: Generated and manually authored drawing scripts use these interfaces.
contracts.review_trigger: A new drawing, input or browser operation.

contracts.name: Version 1 project files and browser capability
contracts.compatibility: Continue opening valid version 1 files with the documented defaults and browser commands.
contracts.change_policy: Review format, SDK, generator and stored project compatibility together.
verification: Run tests/test_project.py and tests/test_desktop.py using unittest discovery.
contracts.rationale: Generated apps refer to these names and users reopen their source across sessions.
contracts.review_trigger: A new project version or host capability.
